MAP NAME: Excelcius V 1.0
MAP CREATORS: ryanparker500, Epicraft321
ABOUT US: This is our second map and this an edition to our series, The Ex Series. Please give us tips and ideas to help us with our TDM!
INFO ABOUT MAP:This map is a 4 team TDM. Player will start of with full leather dyed to which team they are on. Player will also get a stone sword, 2 golden apples, 16 logs, 32 glass, and 16 steak.
